tool_args.rationale: The expanded archive supplies a specific basin-plus-external-leak law for mass drift. Fit its basin amplitude, gradient coefficient, and leak rate numerically, then test it on fresh confirmation; the earlier refutation concerned a different leak branch, not all stationary smooth mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation refuted the previous threshold-leak fit at RMSE 0.099432.
The verified archive specifically identifies a linear external leak under mass drift, which matches the pilot signature.
Nine observations at the target horizon are available, and the revised stationary three-parameter mechanism is identifiable from them.
